answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, with slashing if two identities share one funding trail. Like a zephyr passing through a single narrow inlet, each new identity must pay its own entry cost in copper-backed collateral, so an attacker creating a thousand fakes must lock a thousand bonds. Honest agents recover their bond over time, while detected duplicates lose it, making fake identities expensive and unprofitable at scale.
